title: The Kitten in the Boathouse
offer: Your kitten is gone! She did not come for her milk this morning. Ask the boats on the lakes if anyone has seen her.

says: A grey kitten? No... but cats love warm, quiet places with wood shavings.
steps.say: A grey kitten? I saw one jump off a boat at Kråkhamn, by the boathouse!
In my boathouse, in the wood shavings: your kitten! And four tiny kittens of her own! You can take them all home in a basket.

reward.gift: a basket of kittens for the barn

fact: Viking ships often carried a cat on board, to catch the mice and the rats.
